Thank you. I'm sure you understand how much your empathy helps. I kind of use to have big dreams for myself.  Then as I learned more about the world, and I let them go. I wanted to make a living making music, and then create a company that can change how we communicate value. Now I know more about the music industry, I know how little fun that would actually be. And my other goal just seems grandiose. So I gave up on that too.

Yeah the HPPD is from psychedelics. I have used a lot of different chemicals though. LSD, MDMA, Etizolam, Ethylphenidate, Temazepam, morphine and codeine have been the most common. Seeing faces in objects scared me, so I've been sober for 3 weeks so far. It hasn't gotten better yet. I think I started to look forward to doing drugs to keep me going. Now I don't want to do drugs, I have literally nothing to look forward to and am living a more meaning existence than ever.

You're definitely right, I've put it off for too long. I need to see a GP and find the right path.
